metadata.question: Did Arrachart in Madagascar recieve more than 22 inches of rainfall during the month of January 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Arrachart, Madagascar (need to find coordinates - it's likely a small locality, will use approximate coordinates for Madagascar) - Time: January 2020 (2020-01-01 to 2020-01-31) - Collection: CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) - daily precipitation data at 0.05° resolution 2. Masking strategy: - No masking needed for CHIRPS precipitation data (it doesn't have clouds) - Simply sum all daily precipitation values for January 2020 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: If total precipitation is 0 or any valid number, compare to 22 inches (558.8 mm) - C1: If no images found in collection - C2: If images exist but no valid pixels (unlikely for CHIRPS over land) - C3: If result is null/undefined or calculation fails - A: If rainfall > 22 inches (558.8 mm) - B: If rainfall <= 22 inches ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Arrachart is a small locality in Madagascar, using approximate coordinates // Near the central-eastern region of Madagascar const point = ee.Geometry.Point([47.5, -19.0]); // January 2020 const startDate = '2020-01-01'; const endDate = '2020-02-01'; // CHIRPS daily precipitation data const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(point); const imageCount = chirps.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images found: ${imageCount}`); if (imageCount === 0) { console.log('No precipitation data found for January 2020.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Sum all daily precipitation for the month const totalPrecip = chirps.sum(); // Calculate total precipitation at the point const precipStats = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: point, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const precipValue = precipStats.get('precipitation').getInfo(); // Check for valid pixels const pixelCount = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: point, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels found.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (precipValue === null || precipValue === undefined || isNaN(precipValue)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid result.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Convert 22 inches to mm: 22 * 25.4 = 558.8 mm const thresholdMm = 22 * 25.4; const precipInches = precipValue / 25.4; console.log(`Total rainfall: ${precipValue.toFixed(2)} mm (${precipInches.toFixed(2)} inches)`); console.log(`Threshold: ${thresholdMm.toFixed(2)} mm (22 inches)`); if (precipValue > thresholdMm) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
